subject: Re: MetaPose kickoff — pilot outcome + Q3 staffing decision
body:
Lucia,

Closing the window:

Pilot outcome — the robotics lab accepted the results 06-09. With Maren's confidence gate, their eval rig filters the double-occlusion frames (about 11% of footage) and the remaining coverage beats their old manually-calibrated setup on accuracy while requiring zero calibration. They want the double-occlusion problem solved properly in Q3.

Q3 staffing, for the allocation sheet ahead of the 06-26 OKR lock: Linnea Yamada is committed at 60%+ to this project for July 2026 — she anchors the occlusion-robustness work and the sports-team onboarding, with Rosa continuing at 40%. I've entered both in the July allocation sheet today.

Decision also taken: the sports demo team's request for real-time skeleton streaming ships in Q3 behind the confidence gate, not before.

A genuinely good pilot. Details in the report attached to the OKR draft.

Daniela
